cgp_composition: Existing UseAgonesFleetDeploymentPlanner remains selected by FleetController CGP. Its core active/rolling policies reuse the public sum helper at five sites; Rusternetes supplies the existing storage effects.
conformance: 705locked all-target native checks, including existing real Rusternetes Fleet policy/controller tests, plus the regression for both overflow directions, repeated extremes, None/empty and callback order/count. No live-cluster or executor proof.
consistency: Synchronous calculation over the provided objects; no persistence, retries, event ordering or conditional-write behavior is introduced.
formal_status: Required post-gate typed extraction of all three original tests and protected Bolero/Kani evidence remains open. Current formal credit zero.
inputs: Arbitrary i32 clamp arguments/replica bound, ordered finite iterator of optional GameServerSet references, stateful FnMut field selector returning i32.
ordering_replay: Iterator order and duplicate references are preserved. No selection/callback deduplication.
outputs: i32 replica value; selector invocation sequence is observable.
ownership: Existing core domain types remain canonical; the caller owns the objects and selector.
postconditions: Upper bound returns the smaller input or Fleet.spec.replicas; lower bound returns the greater input orzero.
Sum starts atzero, skips absent references, invokes the selector once for each present reference in input order and adds modulo2^32.
Empty/all-absent collections returnzero without a selector call. The helper does not mutate input objects; captured selector state can change. Selector panic propagates at its invocation.
preconditions: No numeric filtering. Rust borrowing/lifetime requirements apply; missing references use Option::None.
proof_domain: Not yet declared by a new property family; do not infer symbolic exhaustiveness from native examples.
